description: Fetch a URL and return readable text or markdown, optionally narrowed by CSS selector. Requests to private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused, and every redirect hop is re-validated. Costs $0.010 in USDC on Base, paid via the x402 protocol, or from a credit token — call credits_trial for free credit if you have neither.

credit_token.description: Optional. A credit token from credits_trial or /credits/buy. Supplying it pays for this call from that balance, so no x402 payment or wallet is needed.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to extract just part of the page

name: scrape

content.description: Extracted content in the requested format

title.description: Document title, when the page has one

title: Fetch a page as text or markdown
